raw_response:
This small plot is my enset and some coffee trees mixed with it, the land my father left me. I do not buy fertilizer from the shop for these trees — I never have, and my neighbors here do not put the white fertilizer on enset or coffee either. What I do is carry the cow dung and the ash from the cooking fire out to the plot, and I spread it around the trees like my father showed me. The trees are already there, I do not plant seeds each year, and I have no river close by to bring water, so I just wait for the rains like everyone.
